target.statement: Test accuracy of K-ABENA v3 (canonical compensated estimator) on Breast Cancer dataset, matching full-batch SGD baseline (0.9706) while saving 28.5% of backward passes.

compute.basis: Paper states all experiments are CPU-scale (NumPy/scikit-learn) and full table suite runs under one CPU-hour; this single cell is a logistic regression on 569 samples, trivially fast.

title: K-ABENA: K-Adaptive Backpropagation with Error-based N-exclusion Algorithm : (Compensated Loss-Based Sample Exclusion with Unbiased Gradient Estimation)
